text:
maya: Quick sketch idea — `split-lane` layout: top lane is a horizontal spend heatband (hour/day/week density) and bottom lane is a stack of token-breakdown cards per project. Question: where should invoice access live? inline row action vs header CTA? figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxxx/split-lane-heatband

sam: Love the heatband for quick trend signals. Concern: mobile vertical real estate. If we keep heatband, token cards might push invoices off-screen. Can we collapse cards into an expandable accordion? :thinking_face:

jordan: Inline invoice icon on each row makes it discoverable for finance folks, but it does add noise. Header CTA (primary) works for org-wide download. Maybe both: small row action + global header download (less visual weight).

lia: Accessibility nit: heatband needs aria-labels and a non-color visual cue for density (pattern or hatch). Also ensure contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 for small text over the band. Keyboard order: header CTA -> heatband -> token cards should be logical.

maya: Proposal for CTA affordance: small download icon (icon-only button) placed at row end for per-project invoice, and a single primary "Download invoices" in the top-right for bulk. Acceptance criteria we can measure: invoice-click rate, time-to-download test (task completion in prototype), and a11y keyboard flow check.

sam: Experiment suggestion: A/B two variants — A: header-primary + row-icon; B: header-primary-only + invoice in kebab menu. Metrics: #clicks to download, error/retry, support tickets about "where is my invoice".

jordan: Copy nit: change label from "Tokens" to "Token usage" in the card header — clearer for non-technical PMs. Also show a compact per-token cost tooltip.

lia: Also: screen-reader example for the row download button — use `aria-label="Download invoice for Project X, March 2026"`. Example snippet:```html
<button class="icon-btn" aria-label="Download invoice for Project X, March 2026">
  <svg aria-hidden="true"></svg>
</button>````

figma-bot: Uploaded: Figma file "Split-lane spend + token cards" (pages: desktop, tablet, mobile). Link: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxxx/split-lane

maya: Updated the figma with the two CTA variants and a11y notes. Small checklist in the prototype:
- ensure heatband has text alternative (aria-describedby)
- colorblind-friendly palette applied
- keyboard focus visible on invoice icon

sam: I'll mock the mobile accordion behavior and the kebab menu variant, share a prototype by Thu EOD.

jordan: Also small UX ask: show a micro-sparkline in each token card for last 7 days — helps correlate spikes to heatband.

lia: +1 to sparklines. For a11y tests I'll run VoiceOver and NVDA passes on the prototype.

maya: Great, thanks team. We'll evaluate metrics after two-week experiment and pick winner. :thumbsup:
